Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning excise tax relief for nuclear fuel assemblies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax relief for nuclear fuel assemblies;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofnuclear fuel assemblies manufactured or processed for hire in the stateof Washington that are delivered to nuclear powered electricalgenerating stations located in the state of Washington. (2) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of orcharges made for labor and services rendered in respect to preparing,loading, transporting, and delivering nuclear fuel assembliesmanufactured or processed for hire in the state of Washington tonuclear powered electrical generating stations located in the state ofWashington.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse by a manufacturer, processor for hire, or an owner of a nuclearpower generating station located in the state of Washington of nuclearfuel assemblies manufactured or processed for hire in the state ofWashington that are delivered to nuclear powered electrical generatingstations located in the state of Washington. (2) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of labor and services rendered in respect to preparing, loading,transporting, and delivering nuclear fuel assemblies manufactured orprocessed for hire in the state of Washington that are delivered tonuclear powered electrical generating stations located in the state ofWashington.
